title: The Betrayer
summary: As Ha-Jun duels Captain Baek, his academy senior Park Jin-Woo reveals he traded Ha-Jun's coordinates for his sister's life-saving cure. The emotional conflict causes Ha-Jun to hesitate, leading to a catastrophic tactical breach.

panels.shot: captain baek drawing the eclipse greatsword
panels.action: Captain Baek swings the 200-pound jagged greatsword effortlessly in one hand, dark anti-mana humming.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek swings the 200-pound jagged greatsword effortlessly in one hand, dark anti-mana humming.
panels.prose_hi: Captain bake 200 pound ki dantedar badi talwar ko ek haath mein aasani se ghumate han, gahre anti-mana ko gungunate hue.

panels.shot: captain baek charging forward like a meteor
panels.action: Baek kicks off the concrete, leaving a shattered crater as he rockets forward with devastating momentum.
panels.prose_en: Baek kicks off the concrete, leaving a shattered crater as he rockets forward with devastating momentum.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne vinashkari gati ke saath rocket ko aage badhate hue concrete ko laat mari, jisse ek toota hua gaddha ban gaya.

panels.shot: greatsword clashing against ha-jun bone gauntlet
panels.action: Baek's greatsword slams into Ha-Jun's raised left bone gauntlet; a radial shockwave shatters all remaining glass.
panels.prose_en: Baek's greatsword slams into Ha-Jun's raised left bone gauntlet; a radial shockwave shatters all remaining glass.
panels.prose_hi: Bak ki badi talwar Ha-Jun ki ubhari hui bayin haddi ke hathiyar se takrati hai; ek radial shockwev shesh sabhi kaanch ko chaknachur kar deti hai.

panels.shot: concrete floor depressing under ha-jun boots
panels.action: The concrete under Ha-Jun's boots cracks into spiderwebs from the sheer kinetic pressure of Baek's blow.
panels.prose_en: The concrete under Ha-Jun's boots cracks into spiderwebs from the sheer kinetic pressure of Baek's blow.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ke prahar ke tivra gatij dabav se Ha-Jun ke jooton ke neeche ka concrete makdi ke jaalon mein toot jata hai.

panels.shot: captain baek grinning grimly behind visor
panels.action: Baek leans in with veins bulging on his neck: 'Tumhara bone armor sach mein impressive hai, ladke!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Lekin technique bina experience ke sirf ek khilona hai!

panels.prose_en: Baek leans in with veins bulging on his neck: 'Tumhara bone armor sach mein impressive hai, ladke!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek apni gardan par ubhari hui nason ke saath jhukta hai: 'tumhara asthi kavach sach mein prabhavshali hai, ladke!'.

panels.shot: baek executing spinning roundhouse kick
panels.action: Using the greatsword as a fulcrum, Baek swings his titanium-armored boot straight at Ha-Jun's ribs.
panels.prose_en: Using the greatsword as a fulcrum, Baek swings his titanium-armored boot straight at Ha-Jun's ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Gratusward ko aadhar ke roop mein upyog karte hue, bake ne apne titenium-baktarband boot ko sidhe Ha-Jun ki pasliyon par ghumaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun parrying with right blood blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun pivots, his right blood katana sliding along Baek's armor to deflect the kick off-target.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pivots, his right blood katana sliding along Baek's armor to deflect the kick off-target.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhuri, uska dahina khoon katana kick ko lakshya se hatane ke liye bak ke kavach ke saath fisal raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun counter-thrusting toward baek throat
panels.action: Ha-Jun's flaming blood blade darts forward like a striking viper, aimed straight at the unarmored throat gap.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's flaming blood blade darts forward like a striking viper, aimed straight at the unarmored throat gap.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka dhadhkta hua khoon blade ek hadtali saamp ki tarah aage badhta hai, jiska lakshya sidhe nihatthe gale ke antral par hota hai.

panels.shot: sudden gunshot from warehouse catwalk behind hajun
panels.action: A loud sniper gunshot rings out from the overhead catwalk, shattering the blood blade in mid-thrust.
panels.prose_en: A loud sniper gunshot rings out from the overhead catwalk, shattering the blood blade in mid-thrust.
panels.prose_hi: Overhed catwalk se ek tez sniper bandook ki goli ki awaaz aati hai, jo bich-bich mein khoon ke blade ko chaknachur kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping back in shock
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps back ten feet, his shattered blood reforming into his ring, eyes darting to the catwalk.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps back ten feet, his shattered blood reforming into his ring, eyes darting to the catwalk.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun das feet peeche chhalaang lagata hai, uska bikhra hua khoon uski anguthi mein badal jata hai, aankhen catwalk ki or badhti han.

panels.shot: figure holding smoking hunting rifle on catwalk
panels.action: Standing on the catwalk: a slender 19yo boy in a Saint Mirren academy blazer, trembling violently.
panels.prose_en: Standing on the catwalk: a slender 19yo boy in a Saint Mirren academy blazer, trembling violently.
panels.prose_hi: Catwalk par khada: sent miren akadami blazer mein ek patla 19 varshiya ladka, hinsak roop se kamp raha tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun recognizing his senior park jin-woo
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes widen in genuine disbelief: 'Jin-Woo... Senior?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jin-Woo Hyung...? Tum yahan kya kar rahe ho?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes widen in genuine disbelief: 'Jin-Woo... Senior?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen vastavik avishvas se chaudi ho gain: 'jin-woo... sineer?!'.

panels.shot: jin-woo crying with rifle trembling in hands
panels.action: Park Jin-Woo weeps openly, tears streaming down his face as he aims the rifle at Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: jin_woo
dialogue.text: M-Mujhe maaf kar do, Ha-Jun! Mere paas koi aur raasta nahi tha!

panels.prose_en: Park Jin-Woo weeps openly, tears streaming down his face as he aims the rifle at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Park jin-woo khuleaam rota hai, Ha-Jun par rifle ka nishana banate samay uske chehre se aansu bah rahe han.

panels.shot: jin-woo revealing his sick sister motive
panels.action: Jin-Woo holds up a glowing blue pharmaceutical vial in his left hand with desperate sobbing.

dialogue.speaker: jin_woo
dialogue.text: Meri behen Su-Jin terminal mana leukemia se mar rahi hai... Bureau ne kaha agar main tumhari location doon toh woh use cure denge!

panels.prose_en: Jin-Woo holds up a glowing blue pharmaceutical vial in his left hand with desperate sobbing.
panels.prose_hi: Jin-woo ne hatasha bhari siskiyon ke saath apne baen haath mein ek chamakdar neeli pharmaceutical shishi pakad rakhi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun freezing with lowered blades
panels.action: Ha-Jun's arms slowly drop to his sides; the memory of his own lost brother paralyzes his battle instinct.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Apni behen ko bachaane ke liye... Woh bhi wahi kar raha hai jo mere bhai ne mere liye kiya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's arms slowly drop to his sides; the memory of his own lost brother paralyzes his battle instinct.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki bhujaen dhire-dhire uski taraf girti han; apne hi khoe hue bhai ki yaad uski yudh pravritti ko pangu bana deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro screeching frantically from rafters
panels.action: Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN, DEFEND! BAEK IS MOVING! APNE EMOTIONS KO SIDE MEIN RAKHO!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN, DEFEND! BAEK IS MOVING! APNE EMOTIONS KO SIDE MEIN RAKHO!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro bhaybhit hokar chillata hai: 'Ha-Jun, bachav karo! bake chal raha hai! apne emotions ko side mein rakho!'.

panels.shot: captain baek swinging eclipse greatsword at full power
panels.action: Taking full advantage of Ha-Jun's distraction, Captain Baek unleashes his ultimate strike.
panels.prose_en: Taking full advantage of Ha-Jun's distraction, Captain Baek unleashes his ultimate strike.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki vyakulta ka pura fayda uthate hue, captain bak ne apna antim prahar kiya.

panels.shot: greatsword cleaving straight through ha-jun bone gauntlet
panels.action: The anti-mana greatsword strikes Ha-Jun's left forearm with ungodly kinetic force, fracturing the bone plate.
panels.prose_en: The anti-mana greatsword strikes Ha-Jun's left forearm with ungodly kinetic force, fracturing the bone plate.
panels.prose_hi: Man-virodhi mahan talwar Ha-Jun ke bayin baanh par adharmi gatij bal se prahar karti hai, jisse haddi ki plate toot jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun screaming as bone fractures
panels.action: Ha-Jun screams in visceral agony as the shockwave shatters his radius bone beneath the armor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun screams in visceral agony as the shockwave shatters his radius bone beneath the armor.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi shockwev kavach ke neeche uski trijya ki haddi ko todti hai, Ha-Jun aant ki peeda mein chillata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun thrown through three brick walls
panels.action: The titanic impact blasts Ha-Jun backward through three reinforced brick partition walls.
panels.prose_en: The titanic impact blasts Ha-Jun backward through three reinforced brick partition walls.
panels.prose_hi: Titanik prabhav teen prabalit int vibhajan diwaron ke madhyam se Ha-Jun ko peeche ki or visphotit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun lying in mountain of brick rubble
panels.action: Ha-Jun lies half-buried under crushed red bricks, blood pouring from his forehead and broken left arm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lies half-buried under crushed red bricks, blood pouring from his forehead and broken left arm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun kuchli hui lal inton ke neeche aadha daba hua hai, uske mathe se khoon bah raha hai aur bayan haath toota hua hai.

panels.shot: captain baek walking through the dust cloud
panels.action: Captain Baek steps through the shattered archway, dragging his blood-stained greatsword.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek steps through the shattered archway, dragging his blood-stained greatsword.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak apni khoon se sunny badi talwar ko ghasitate hue, toote hue toran dwar se hokar gujarta hai.

panels.shot: baek looking at ha-jun with pity and respect
panels.action: Baek stops three feet away: 'Combat mein hesitation sirf maut laati hai, boy. Tumhara dil bohot naram hai.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Dushman par reham karna jung mein sabse bada gunaah hai.

panels.prose_en: Baek stops three feet away: 'Combat mein hesitation sirf maut laati hai, boy. Tumhara dil bohot naram hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek teen feet door rukta hai: 'mukable mein jhijhak sirf maut laati hai, ladke. 'tumhara dil bahut naram hai.'

panels.shot: baek raising greatsword high for finishing cleave
panels.action: Baek raises the massive blade two-handed, poised to plunge it directly into Ha-Jun's heart.
panels.prose_en: Baek raises the massive blade two-handed, poised to plunge it directly into Ha-Jun's heart.
panels.prose_hi: Bek do hathon se vishal blade uthata hai, jo ise sidhe Ha-Jun ke dil mein dubaane ke liye taiyar hai.

panels.shot: kuro diving down with blinding purple smoke bomb
panels.action: Kuro plunges between them, his wings exploding into a blinding 30-meter screen of choking purple demonic miasma.
panels.prose_en: Kuro plunges between them, his wings exploding into a blinding 30-meter screen of choking purple demonic miasma.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro unke beech girta hai, uske pankh dam ghutne wali baingani shaitani demonic mayasma ki 30 meter ki chakachaundh screen mein fat jaate han.

panels.shot: baek coughing and slashing through smoke
panels.action: Baek swings blindly through the dense purple fog, but his blade strikes only empty air.
panels.prose_en: Baek swings blindly through the dense purple fog, but his blade strikes only empty air.
panels.prose_hi: Bak ghane baingani kohre mein aankh band karke ghumta hai, lekin uska blade keval khali hawa par hamla karta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae driving forklift through side wall
panels.action: Min-Jae smashes an industrial forklift through a corrugated metal side door into the smoke.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae smashes an industrial forklift through a corrugated metal side door into the smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek audyogik forklift ko nalidar lohe ke darvaje ke madhyam se dhuen mein tod deta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae pulling unconscious ha-jun onto forklift pallet
panels.action: Min-Jae frantically drags Ha-Jun's limp, bleeding body onto the wooden pallet.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae frantically drags Ha-Jun's limp, bleeding body onto the wooden pallet.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne Ha-Jun ke langade, langde shareer ko lakdi ke foos par khinch liya.

panels.shot: forklift reversing into rainy alleyway
panels.action: Min-Jae slams the forklift into reverse, bursting out into the pouring rain as smoke billows behind them.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae slams the forklift into reverse, bursting out into the pouring rain as smoke billows behind them.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne forklift ko ulta patak diya, jisse tej baarish ke beech dhuan nikalta hua unke peeche se nikal gaya.

panels.shot: captain baek emerging from smoke staring at rain
panels.action: Captain Baek lowers his sword, wiping purple soot from his cheek: 'Bhag gaye... Lekin uski haddiyan toot chuki hain.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Woh kal subah tak zinda nahi bachega.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek lowers his sword, wiping purple soot from his cheek: 'Bhag gaye... Lekin uski haddiyan toot chuki hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak ne apni talwar neeche kar lee aur apne gaal se baingani kalikh ponchte hue kaha: 'bhag gaye... lekin uski hadiyan toot chuki han.'
